description: This file implements utility functions for network operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including interface description loading, command execution, IP address validation, file handling, environment variable retrieval, and address type checks.

classes.name: NetUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing network-related functions such as interface description, command execution, IP validation, and address checks.

methods.name: InitialiseNetUtils
methods.description: Initializes network utilities by loading interface descriptions.

methods.name: _loadInterfaceDescriptions
methods.description: Loads network interface descriptions based on environment variables.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescription
methods.description: Returns description for a given network interface.

methods.name: execCmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command, captures output, and optionally retrieves the command result and output file.

methods.name: isIPV4
methods.description: Checks if an address is in IPv4 format.

methods.name: isIPV6
methods.description: Checks if an address is in IPv6 format.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file, optionally deleting it after reading.

methods.name: envGetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key from the device properties file.

methods.name: getTmpFilename
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary filename based on input and a counter.

methods.name: isIPV6LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is link-local.

methods.name: isIPV4LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is link-local.

methods.name: _isCharacterIllegal
methods.description: Determines if a character is illegal in endpoint URLs.

methods.name: isValidEndpointURL
methods.description: Validates if an endpoint URL contains only allowed characters.
